reviews.text:
An excellent veterinary clinic! A very professional, welcoming, and attentive team, both with the animals and their owners. The veterinarians take the time to explain things and truly care about the well-being of our little companions.
Thank you for your kindness, your availability, and the quality of your care. I recommend this clinic without hesitation!

What a relief and what a joy to have found the Saint-Paul veterinary clinic! I have complete faith in this team. My dogs have been treated there for three years now, and I feel a genuine commitment from the veterinarians. Furthermore, at each appointment, they take the time to explain the purpose of each treatment. I saw several vets before finding them, and this is the first time I've felt so at ease: they never push for unnecessary expenses, and every suggested examination is perfectly justified and detailed. And above all, the veterinarians take their time when examining them. Admittedly, the prices reflect their location in the center of Paris, but being fortunate enough to be able to afford it, I'd say that this peace of mind is priceless.
They've been taking care of my cats for 9 years. A very good clinic.
Very friendly and attentive

I called this veterinary clinic this evening because my immunocompromised dog had an urgent eye problem. I was put on hold for 10 minutes, then they seemed to have forgotten I was still on the phone—I eventually had to hang up and call back myself. When I finally got through to someone, I was told they couldn't see her for about a week.

What I don't understand is the point of advertising emergency services on your website and advising people to call in case of an emergency, only to then act as if those services don't actually exist. I clearly stated that it was an emergency and that she needed to be seen this evening, even though there were still several hours before closing time. There may have been a misunderstanding with the receptionist, but the experience felt very unsympathetic, unhelpful, and rather rushed. I agree. I think there’s some bias towards foreigners here.
Thank you for the products and availability hours

Fantastic veterinary clinic, especially thanks to Dr. Cartiaux. I've been going there with my cat for two years now and I always feel completely at ease. He's very kind, gentle with animals, and always takes the time to explain and reassure them. You can tell he's passionate about what he does, and it makes all the difference. I highly recommend him without hesitation!
Wonderful experience, great professionals, clean space, warm environment and personnel

Thank you for the advice this morning, the prescribed medication, and for listening... It's a bit of a delicate situation for me! I was able to put my two somewhat feral cats, recently rescued from a shelter, in their suitcase... They came home on their own, driven by hunger, with a little sedation, of course, but it was effective, so there was no violence for either of them... Thank you so much!
I warmly thank Dr. Colas for the compassionate care she provided to Poky until her final moments. Thank you also to the entire team for your availability and support during this difficult time.

A huge thank you to the entire team, and especially to Dr. Colas, for his gentleness and kindness.
Thanks to you, the care we received for our dog during his final moments will remain a peaceful and tender memory.
Great vet

The whole team is wonderful with our four-legged friends.
Thank you for your empathy.
I am recommending I trust them

Thank you to the entire team at Clinique Saint Paul, especially Dr. Flachaire, who knew Orrus, our English bulldog, from puppyhood and cared for him for the last 10 years, right up until his passing.
She was incredibly professional and patient, explaining things clearly and clearly. A truly empathetic person.
Letting go of a pet is a terrible ordeal. But we want to be there for them during their final moments.
Thank you to her for being there for him in this last act of love 🙏❤️

She was so discreet, generous, and kind.
She found the perfect, comforting words that eased our sadness.
She is a truly beautiful soul!
We highly recommend this veterinary clinic.

Cyril & Michel
Perfect. Honest and competent. My cat is gone, but at least he was in good hands during his final moments.

I love Drs. Flachaire and Cartiaux, as well as the entire team at Clinique Saint Paul, because they saved my life when I was only two months old and had feline panleukopenia (feline distemper).

Today, I'm about to celebrate my first birthday, and they continue to take such good care of me!
Thank you so much,
Sweet kisses,
Charlotte❤️

Each member of staff takes excellent care of our animals.
Everything is explained at each consultation, and they don't hesitate to seek external opinions to confirm their diagnosis. I have complete confidence in their professionalism and compassion.
My dog ​​is eager to get into the clinic every time I visit; that's how comfortable he is there!
Thank you to the entire team.

We want to thank Doctors Flachaire, Cartiaux, Christine, and their entire team for taking such excellent care of Martin for over six years. Thank you for your professionalism, your attentiveness, your availability, and the love and compassion you show our companions. We have complete confidence in them.

Eugénio and Patrice
This place is wonderful. The doctors are excellent and thorough, and love what they do. We are so fortunate to have them in the neighborhood! 😍❤️ …

I was able to see Dr. Cartiaux again, the doctor who cared for my little Kanel during her first two years in Levallois. She's now 10 and a half. He's a very gentle and attentive doctor. He explains everything and keeps you informed. And Dr. Cartiaux isn't the only one who can speak to me; the entire staff is truly wonderful.

The best veterinary practice I've ever been to.

Thank you all for your professionalism!

Our little Lenny has been a patient at the clinic for years. He's 6 years old, and on two occasions already, Dr. Flachaire's expertise has allowed for extremely effective interventions and the anticipation of potential complications. We all know that vets love animals, but his dedication to keeping them healthy is truly incredible. His skill and professionalism are remarkable. Furthermore, when we were seen by another vet at the clinic, it was a fantastic experience. The assistants are very kind and efficient. We recommend them 100%.

We called the clinic this Sunday because we were concerned about a problem our cat was having. The woman we spoke to on the phone kindly agreed to answer our questions as best she could remotely and reassured us. Thank you so much for this simple yet incredibly kind and helpful gesture!

These people are always kind. They are always friendly. They always take very good care of my old dog. They are quite busy and there is a reason for that. I feel very confident that my dog is getting the best care available

We are absolutely delighted with the care our pug receives from the entire team at this veterinary clinic. From our very first visit, we were greeted with immense kindness and patience. The staff is attentive, always ready to answer our questions and offer sound advice regarding our dog's health, nutrition, and well-being.

The veterinarians demonstrate great professionalism and truly take the time to examine each animal gently and attentively. You can tell they love their work and are committed to providing the best possible care. Our dog is treated with such kindness that he tries to come inside every time we walk by.

We wholeheartedly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a competent, compassionate, and passionate veterinarian. A huge thank you to the entire team for their dedication and commitment!

I took my cat there to be neutered. The appointment was quick to schedule, and they clearly explained what would happen both on the phone and in person the morning of the operation.

I also had my cat's claws trimmed and he received a deworming treatment.

I was also able to register him in France since he comes from abroad.

A very good experience.
Excellent clinic

This veterinary clinic is incredibly caring towards both animals and their owners; it's just like going to the pediatrician for our children! Thank you to this wonderful team who are always so attentive to our concerns! Lady and her owners :)

Thank you for the clarity of your information, the discussion of the difficult strategies and the impossible choice. Thank you for giving us the time to say goodbye as a family, thank you for your support and your humanity. For Ozzy.
Modern veterinary practice. Very friendly staff and an attentive veterinarian. The staff speak English, which made things much easier for us. Highly recommended.

I brought in a cat I found abandoned in the street. The manager kept it with the intention of finding it a new home, even though she could have told me to go to the animal shelter, etc.
They love animals at this establishment :)

Thank you to the manager!

I chose this clinic on the recommendation of a friend who had had their cat neutered there. He told me they were reputable and that he'd even received free cat food. What also convinced me was that they offered a bodysuit instead of a cone after the operation, which seemed more comfortable for my cat. Even though it wasn't the closest clinic to my home and the prices were higher than elsewhere, I preferred to go there to provide my cat with better conditions after the operation.
Unfortunately, what followed was very stressful and ultimately shocking. Two days after the operation, my cat was very weak and became ill. I rushed back to the clinic, and the veterinarian was alarming and stressful about his condition, directly mentioning serious illnesses without trying to reassure me. At no point did they consider that my cat might have contracted a bacterial infection at the clinic, even though he'd spent an entire day there after the operation, which had undoubtedly weakened him. I had to return four times, and each time I was seen by veterinarians who were neither friendly nor encouraging. I spent a total of 400 euros without receiving a single apology or any questioning of their care, despite the fact that my cat became ill right after a routine neutering procedure. No goodwill gesture, no special attention, nothing.

In addition to the cost, it was a real source of stress and anxiety for me. I even had to do my own research to reassure myself, because I received no clear explanations or support. I find it truly shocking and unacceptable that the clinic behaved this way, especially since it's highly likely they bear some responsibility for what happened. For all these reasons, I strongly advise against using this clinic.
High professionalism, empathy, kindness and a definite love for animals are just some of the qualities of Doctors Cartiaux and Flachaire and their team.
Simply the best vet in town, thank you for everything and all these years of caring for us 🙏🏼🐶 …

One of the best veterinary clinics I've ever had the pleasure of visiting.

The nurses and veterinarians are attentive and responsive to the animals' needs and treat them like their own.

I highly recommend them for a health check-up or for any other care your pet may require.

Edit: My cat, who had kidney failure, was on the verge of death, and they did everything they could; she's alive thanks to them.
Excellent rapport with both animals and humans. Perfect care. +++
Excellent, very careful veterinarian
Excellent service, the problem was resolved with care and attention. I recommend them.
